notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.subtitle: What this server has told you. kasl shows the same notices on your machines; reading them here stops the toasts.
notifications.none: Nothing yet. When the server tells your manager something about your days, when a manager writes a note on one of your days or answers a day you reported, when a machine starts or stops reporting as you, or when what is stored about you changes, you are told here and on your machine.

notes.withdrawConfirm: Withdraw this note? Its words are removed for them too.

reports.changedHint: kasl sent this day again with other figures, so the report no longer stands for it. Report it again once it is right.
reports.returnedHint: Correct the day in kasl if it is wrong, then report it again - or report it as it is, if it is right.
reports.ownHint: Reporting a day tells your manager it is finished, and asks them to approve its hours.
reports.openDay: The day is still open. It can be reported once kasl has finished it.
reports.reasonLabel: Why is the day of {{date}} sent back?
reports.reasonPlaceholder: What they should look at - a missing break, an end that looks wrong
reports.reasonHint: They are told on their machine and in their inbox, with these words.

setting.title: Day approval
setting.label: Managers approve the days people report
setting.on: Days are approved here: a person reports a finished day, and their manager approves its hours or sends it back with a reason.
setting.off: Days are not approved here. A day reported from kasl is the person saying it is finished, and nothing waits for an answer.
